groups.description: Live residential property portals this domain is modeled on — useful to see how seeker, owner, and agent surfaces are positioned in practice.

links.title: Zillow — U.S. property search
links.relevance: The defining U.S. portal benchmark for search, valuation, and financing adjacency that the home-buyer / tenant-seeker persona evaluates against.

links.title: Rightmove — U.K. property portal
links.relevance: The clearest agent-led search benchmark; grounds how the professional supply operator persona buys visibility and qualified demand.

links.title: Realtor.com — listings and agent leads
links.relevance: A major portal benchmark for seller products and agent lead flow relevant to both owner and agent personas.

groups.description: Background on housing demand, affordability pressure, and market structure that shapes the domain's strategy.

links.title: HUD — Worst Case Housing Needs
links.relevance: Quantifies unmet U.S. housing need, the affordability pressure that makes search efficiency and pricing confidence more valuable for the home-buyer / tenant-seeker persona.

links.title: CoStar Group — investor relations
links.relevance: Primary-source view of the Homes.com challenger model and portal economics that pressure agent monetization across the supply side.

groups.description: How marketplaces frame listing integrity and the enforcement that governs rental and listing claims.

links.title: FTC — action against deceptive rental listing websites
links.relevance: Enforcement precedent showing fake or stale listings destroy trust, driving the verification and freshness controls the seeker and broker-integration personas rely on.

groups.description: Resources aimed at professional agents and the software partners that supply and sync listings programmatically.

links.title: Zillow Group — newsroom
links.relevance: Primary-source updates on agent products, lead models, and partner programs that frame the professional supply operator persona's monetization choices.
